title: hydrocotyle hirsuta var. moschata
intro: Hydrocotyle hirsuta var. moschata, commonly known as Bearberry or also as Indian Pennywort, is a type of plant used in traditional medicine. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Bearberry are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Bearberry include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
